project_name.justification: The text identifies the project of interest directly: 'Victoria has acquired Sabre’s 100% interest in the Brewery Creek property...'

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified at the beginning of the press release: 'Victoria Gold Corp. (TSX-VGCX) (“Victoria” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce the acquisition of Sabre Gold Mines Corp.’s (TSX-SGLD) (“Sabre”) Yukon assets...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the acquiring company, Victoria Gold Corp., is quoted in the text: 'Mr. John McConnell, President and CEO of Victoria commented: “With the acquisition of Sabre’s Yukon assets, we are pleased to be expanding our footprint and asset base in our own backyard.”'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text explicitly states the percentage of interest acquired: 'Victoria has acquired Sabre’s 100% interest in the Brewery Creek property...'

primary_commodity.justification: The resource estimate for the Brewery Creek project is described in terms of gold: '...a Mineral Resource Estimate1 of 34.5 million tonnes of Measured and Indicated Mineral Resources grading 1.03g/t Au, containing 1.14 million ounces of gold...'

verified_article_link.justification: The provided text is a consolidation of documents and does not contain a verifiable article link.

currency.justification: The currency for the transaction is specified in the text: 'All currency amounts listed in Canadian dollars.'

cash_payments_raw.justification: The consideration is a mix of guaranteed cash and elective cash/share payments for three properties. The total value is allocated to the `cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw` field and divided by the number of projects.

share_payments_raw.justification: The consideration is a mix of guaranteed cash and elective cash/share payments for three properties. The total value is allocated to the `cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw` field and divided by the number of projects.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: The value is calculated as one-third of the total aggregate consideration of $13.5 million, as the acquisition was for three properties (Brewery Creek, Gold Dome, and Grew Creek). The text states: 'Victoria will pay aggregate consideration of $13.5 million for Golden Predator... which indirectly holds a 100% interest in the Brewery Creek property, as well as certain other mineral assets that include the Gold Dome and Grew Creek exploration properties.'

resource_size.justification: The text provides a detailed mineral resource estimate for the Brewery Creek property: 'The property is the subject of a NI 43-101 Technical Report which sets out a Mineral Resource Estimate1 of 34.5 million tonnes of Measured and Indicated Mineral Resources grading 1.03g/t Au, containing 1.14 million ounces of gold and 36.0 million tonnes of Inferred Mineral Resources grading 0.88g/t Au, containing 1.02 million ounces of gold (effective date of Mineral Resource Estimate: May 31, 2020).'
